create_HybridMotorModel: create a HybridMotorModel instance with a given number of motors and PD control gains
compute_get_motor_torques: compute motor torques from motor commands using position, torque, or hybrid control mode
set_motor_gains: set the proportional and derivative PD gains for all motors in the HybridMotorModel
get_motor_states: get interpolated motor angles and velocities from the observation buffer with configurable latency
compute_hybrid_action_torques: compute hybrid mode motor torques using per-motor position gain, velocity gain, and feedforward torque
